meta.title: Privacy
meta.description: What personal data {name} collects, why, how long we keep it, who processes it, and your rights under Tunisian law.

hero.title: Your data,
hero.lede: We collect as little as we can, only to answer you and to save your projects.

draft.title: Draft, pending legal review
draft.body: This notice has not yet been reviewed by a lawyer. Periods marked “to be confirmed” will be set before launch.

controller.title: Who is responsible
controller.body: {name} is the data controller for this website. Contact us at <email></email> about anything on this page.

collected.title: What we collect
collected.lede: Only what each part of the site needs.

signIn.title: Signing in
signIn.body: Your email address, to send the sign-in link. If you use Google, the name and email Google shares with us.

projects.title: Saved projects
projects.body: The hotel name you give, the tool inputs (rooms, city, pool, electricity price) and the results.

requests.title: Study requests
requests.body: Your name, email, phone (optional), hotel name, city, rooms, pool, electricity price (optional), your message, and your consent.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.body: Cookie-free, aggregated page statistics. We don't track you across sites and don't build a profile of you.

collected.noTool: Using the sizing tool without signing in stores nothing about you.

purposes.title: Why we use it
items: To sign you in and keep your projects.
To answer your study request and prepare a quote.
To understand which pages are useful, in aggregate.
purposes.never: We never sell your data or use it for advertising.

basis.title: Legal basis
basis.body: Your consent, which you give when you sign up or tick the box on a form. You can withdraw it at any time; we then delete the data unless the law requires us to keep it.

items.account: Account and saved projects: until you delete them or your account, then {period}.
items.requests: Study requests: {period} after our last exchange.

processors.title: Who processes it for us
processors.lede: These providers store or send data on our behalf, under contract.

resend.name: Resend
resend.role: Emails: sign-in links and replies to study requests

processors.transfer: Some of these providers store data outside Tunisia. Where the law requires it, we will ask the INPDP for authorisation before any transfer.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: Under Tunisian law (Organic Law 2004-63 on the protection of personal data), you can ask to access, correct or delete your data, and object to its use. Write to <email></email>. If you are not satisfied, you can complain to the INPDP, Tunisia's data protection authority.

changes.title: Changes
changes.body: If we change this notice, we update the date at the top. Material changes are announced on the site.
